title: Digital and Card Access Limits on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
Access to a Savings & Money Market Accounts balance is bounded by six per-tier parameters: whether money market checks can be written on the account, whether an ATM card can withdraw from it, the most cash that can be withdrawn at ATMs per calendar day, the most value that can be transferred out through online or mobile banking per calendar day, and the most check value deposited through mobile deposit per calendar day and in any rolling 30 calendar days.

| Tier | Money market checks | ATM card access | ATM cash per calendar day | Online or mobile transfers out per calendar day | Mobile deposit per calendar day | Mobile deposit in any rolling 30 calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | no | yes | 500.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 1000.00 USD | 3000.00 USD |
| Statement Savings | no | yes | 500.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | 7500.00 USD |
| Goal Builder Savings | no | no | 0.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | 7500.00 USD |
| Money Market Account | yes | yes | 800.00 USD | 25000.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 15000.00 USD |
| Premier Money Market | yes | yes | 1000.00 USD | 50000.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 30000.00 USD |
| Private Client Money Market | yes | yes | 2500.00 USD | 250000.00 USD | 25000.00 USD | 75000.00 USD |

### Notes

Goal Builder Savings is the only tier without ATM card access, and its ATM cash parameter is accordingly 0.00 USD. Money market checks are available on the three money market tiers only.

The two mobile deposit parameters run together: the rolling 30 calendar day figure is three times the daily figure on every tier of the product.

On a hypothetical Statement Savings account, mobile deposits of 2500.00 USD on each of two days within one rolling 30 calendar day span reach 5000.00 USD against the 7500.00 USD parameter, while a single mobile deposit of 2600.00 USD exceeds that tier's 2500.00 USD daily parameter.
